description: NaScP₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-3.02 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Sc-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.17 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-45°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.63 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ScO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-49°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sc and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sc, and one P atom.
